post_title: Social media handles in DS-160 for visa stamping
concerns_or_questions_summary: Product designer who recently completed an H-1B change of status and filed I-485 is planning to travel to Korea for H-1B visa stamping. With around ten social media handles across LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok (many tied to a non-profit design community), they ask whether listing so many accounts on the DS-160 could be a red flag during the social-media review.
